name: kubelatch
description: Kubernetes through kubelatch: its MCP server, a skill with the rules, a hook that stops direct kubectl, helm and k9s, and a hook that opens the approval page in your browser.

kubelatch_url.title: kubelatch URL
kubelatch_url.description: The address you open kubelatch at, such as https://kubelatch.example.com, without /mcp and without a trailing slash

open_approvals.title: Open approval and request pages in your browser
open_approvals.description: When an agent's call waits for you, open its approval or request page in your browser (not in the terminal client, which asks you itself)
